limitations: The confirmation no longer shows the R- reference unless a file fails. The walkthrough should read the reference from Open request or Your requests.

An Administrator can place the built-in Department Row on the intake Form. The Portal then shows a second Department question beside the fixed Department basic. The guide does not describe that configuration. Commit db7d9f0e fills the Row from the basic answer on the MCP path only; I did not settle how the Portal reconciles two answers.
The V-C09 prerequisite 'An active request type with required Fields' now means required Intake Rows on the destination type's Form. Since DD-028 the request type itself carries no Fields.
The 256 MB and 20-Request hourly limits come from source constants; no walkthrough has exercised them.
